## Download and use this snapshot

This page describes the published files in `nicktempleman/csoai-council-of-ai`. Treat them as a dated snapshot: use the observation dates and limitations in the files and source notes below. A page edit does not refresh the measurements.

With the Kaggle CLI installed and authenticated:

```bash
kaggle datasets download -d nicktempleman/csoai-council-of-ai -p ./dataset --unzip
```

Start by inspecting `metadata.jsonl`. Keep its original bytes and record the Kaggle version before transforming or comparing results.

Published files include:

- `README.md`
- `manifest.jsonl`
- `metadata.jsonl`
- `coliseum_hero_arena.jpg`
- `verifiable_evidence_card.jpg`
- `The_CSOAI_Ecosystem_Lifecycle.png`
- `The_CSOAI_Coliseum_Governance_Game.png`
- `CSOAI_s_RAS_AI_Compliance_Framework.png`

[Current GSPC board](https://councilof.ai/api/gspc) · [Methodology](https://councilof.ai/methodology/) · [Verify supported signed records](https://councilof.ai/gspc-verify/) · [Corrections](https://councilof.ai/claim-maintenance)

Apply the licence shown on this dataset. Published by Council of AI — Council for the Safety of Artificial Intelligence, operated by CSOAI Ltd. Measurement is not certification; a mirror or package is not evidence of current board admission or benchmark leadership.

# Council of AI — org assets

Independent measurement body (CSOAI Ltd, UK Companies House 16939677). We measure AI systems on published, frozen splits, sign the card, and re-attest. We do not certify, accredit, or act as a notified body.

Living board: GET https://councilof.ai/api/gspc — 23 axes · 23 measured. Jail is a measured floor, not a 16th pane. Do not freeze a table here.

Verify free: https://councilof.ai/gspc-verify
Council OS: https://councilof.ai/os
Arena: https://councilof.ai/gspc-arena
Home: https://councilof.ai
Cards: GET https://councilof.ai/api/cards — do not say every catalogued card verifies. Verify against the published key.

Measurement, not certification. No prices on this card. No SOV names.

## Dataset facts (checked 2026-11-20)

- Kaggle version 1, last updated 2026-10-06.
- 8 files, 15,228,106 bytes. File types: .png (3), .jpg (2), .jsonl (2), .md (1).
- Hugging Face twin: [csoai/council-of-ai](https://huggingface.co/datasets/csoai/council-of-ai). 7 of 8 files have the same byte size there.
- Expected update frequency: never.
